definitions.explanation: The end or tip of a finger. Used both literally (physical fingertip) and in expressions describing delicate actions, sensations, or fine motor skills.

examples.japanese: {指先|ゆびさき}が{冷|つめ}たい。
{指先|ゆびさき}で{軽|かる}く{触|ふ}れた。
examples.english: I touched it lightly with my fingertip.

examples.japanese: {職人|しょくにん}の{指先|ゆびさき}から{生|う}まれる{繊細|せんさい}な{作品|さくひん}に{感動|かんどう}した。
examples.english: I was moved by the delicate works created by the craftsman's fingertips.

notes:
USAGE:
{指先|ゆびさき} is a compound of {指|ゆび} (finger) and {先|さき} (tip). It often appears in descriptions of delicate work, physical sensations, or skillful handling. In Japanese, {指先|ゆびさき} can also refer to toe tips, though this usage is less common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指先|ゆびさき}が{器用|きよう}: to be dexterous
- {指先|ゆびさき}で{触|さわ}る: to touch with one's fingertips
- {指先|ゆびさき}まで{神経|しんけい}が{行|い}き{届|とど}く: to pay attention to every detail
- {冷|つめ}たい{指先|ゆびさき}: cold fingertips
